subject: Data description entry
notes: docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5 row A.4.14 (VALIDATE — Not claimed) + §4 item 3. Licence: Annex A.4.1, "An implementation shall accept the syntax and provide the functionality for an optional element only when support for that language element is claimed by the implementor", and its second sentence carrying the licence to the module's unlisted rules. Obsolescence (F.2 item 5) is corroboration, never the licence (kb/Work PB198). GR-13.16.4-4 is the Format-4-only general rule of the data description entry ("88 [ condition-name-2 ] value-clause ."). The condition-name is OPTIONAL in this format, and the UNNAMED shape is the one a binder-hook implementation would have dropped in silence (DataBinder.BindCondition returns early without entry.dataName()) — which is why the refusal is a parse-tree pass.
